sloka: ह्रियमाणां तदा वीरो न तु मां वेद लक्ष्मणः ।। ५.३८.६१।।।।
transliteration: hriyamāṇāṁ tadā vīro na tu māṁ veda lakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 5.38.61।।।।

translations.english: "Heroic Lakshmana, did not know while I was borne away. He is prosperous, foremost in serving elders. He is energetic and reserved in his speech like my fatherinlaw. He is a prince dear (to his brother).
